ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: A particle starts from rest and moves according to the law shown in the figure. Which of the following statements is correct?
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Multi-Physics open-ended question 1
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: A particle starts from rest and moves according to the law shown in the figure. Before reaching the position farthest from the starting point, in what direction does the particle move? At what moment is it farthest from the starting point?
ready1_open_rewrite.expected_answer: The particle always moves in the positive direction, and is farthest from the starting point at 2t0.

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_answer: The particle always moves in the positive direction, and is farthest from the starting point at 2t0.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the graph: The figure is a graph of acceleration a changing with time t. Between 0 and t0, the acceleration curve is above the time axis, forming a positive triangle, with the vertex approximately at t0/2 and height a0; between t0 and 2t0, the acceleration curve is below the time axis, forming a negative triangle, with the lowest point approximately at 3t0/2 and size -a0. The bases of the two triangles are both t0, and the magnitudes of the heights are both a0, so the magnitudes of the directed areas are equal and the signs are opposite. Then reason: The particle starts from rest, and the velocity at any moment is equal to the directed area of the a-t graph from 0 to that moment. From 0 to t0, the accumulated area is positive, and the velocity increases from 0 to a positive value; from t0 to 2t0, although the acceleration is negative, the negative area only gradually cancels the previous positive area, and it is not completely canceled until 2t0, so before 2t0 the velocity is always positive. A positive velocity means that the particle has been moving away from the starting point in the positive direction; at t=2t0 the velocity becomes 0, the displacement reaches its maximum, and at this time it is farthest from the starting point.
